title: Update tests for a11y + correctness fixes
description: Update ChatAreaComposer.test.tsx for: tabIndex change on Trash2 (query by role when hidden), aria-live region for copy, Paperclip focus ring test. Update ChatArea.test.tsx for debounce.cancel() API change. Add vi.unstubAllGlobals cleanup.

src/components/ChatAreaComposer.test.tsx contains 'sr-only' or 'role.*status' for copy announcement test
src/components/ChatAreaComposer.test.tsx Trash2 visible test asserts both not opacity-0 AND has opacity-100

files.target: Trash2 tests, copy tests, add cleanup
files.change: Update Trash2 query for tabIndex; add copy live region test; add Paperclip focus test; add vi.unstubAllGlobals; add opacity-100 positive assertion

implementation: Trash2 hidden test: Replace getByTitle('clear draft') + opacity-0 assertion with: query the button, assert it has tabIndex='-1' attribute when input is empty, assert NOT toHaveAttribute('tabindex') when input has text.
Copy live region: After clicking copy, assert screen.getByRole('status').textContent contains 'Copied!'. After advancing timers 1500ms, assert the status region is empty.
Paperclip focus: Add test verifying the Paperclip button has class 'focus-visible:ring-2'.
Add afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals()) to the copy test describe block to clean up navigator stub.
Trash2 visible: Add expect(button).toHaveClass('opacity-100') alongside the existing not.toHaveClass('opacity-0').
ChatArea debounce: If any tests directly call debouncedPersist(), update to debouncedPersist.call().
